items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And then there was another man named Strohler. He was from Algiers, Mr. Strohler.

ctx.x: We just got tired. You know? They just keep you. Yeah. And the people would go to the show and say, is Mac and Mac here? No. Mac's Mary, no. Well, we're not coming. Then we have to come back. Just keep, just coming back, coming back, coming back. Yeah.
Yeah, we worked there at one lot, there at Louisiana Avenue and Howard, for 14 weeks. And then there was another man named Strohler. He was from Algiers, Mr. Strohler.
